## Clinical justification

This patient has a four-week history of progressive loss of central neurological function: progressive right arm weakness and speech difficulty. He has short-term memory difficulties noted by his family. He has a pacemaker in situ, which means an urgent MRI brain scan is contraindicated. CT brain with contrast has been arranged as an alternative imaging modality. I am making a 2WW brain and CNS referral. Primary CNS tumour is in the differential; primary CNS tumour as an alternative to brain metastasis is noted.
